description:
A screenshot of the EAGLE (Europe's eyes on Earth) user interface, specifically the "Data Catalogue" section. The main view displays a table with data entries under headings: "EAGLE Approved", "Name", "Type", "Created At", "Created By", "Country", "Region", "Reference Year", "Time Range", "Organisation/s", "Status", and "Resolution". The table shows 10 items out of 140, with resolutions of either "10 m" or "100 m". For instance, "ES616_roads" and "ES616_10m" have a 10 m resolution and a "DRAFT" status, created on 25.09.2026. "Extraccion_es616_100m" is "EXTRACTED" at 100 m resolution, created on 18.09.2026.

Overlaid on the catalogue is an "Add Extraction" modal window. This window contains input fields for "Name*", "Country*", and "Region (Select a country)". Below these fields are two radio button options for resolution: "100 meters" (selected) and "10 meters" (disabled). A tooltip next to the disabled "10 meters" option reads: "This functionality has been disabled by the administrator."

The top navigation bar includes "Data Catalogue", "EAGLE Ontology", "About EAGLE", "Organisations", and "Users". Action buttons visible in the main view include "Filter", "My organisation/s", "My data", "Ingestions", "Extractions", "100 meters", "10 meters", "Search", "ADD INGESTION", and "ADD EXTRACTION". The bottom of the interface displays logos for "Copernicus", "EAGLE (Europe's eyes on Earth)", "European Commission", and "European Environment Agency".
